notes.title: Project Grove Demo Patch 1.06 Notes
notes.notes:
Thank you for all your feedback about the beginning of the demo. You've highlighted some really key areas that we've been able to dedicate time to.

Updates

 Improved opening with narrative context
 Improvements to subtitles
 Unreal Engine and Antler Studios screens while the Start Screen loads

notes.title: Project Grove Demo Patch 1.02 Notes
notes.notes:
In the lead up to Project Grove's Kickstarter campaign, we're going to be doing as many updates as we can to make sure you get the best experience of Project Grove possible. Once we launch on Kickstarter, the team will continuing working hard to update the demo and fixes are likely to be released in major updates. 

Updates in Project Grove Demo 1.02
Fixes

 Option screen background closes completely in Main Menu
 Mouse no longer vanishes in Menus when pressed and camera stays still in Menus
 Clicking on the text of a shortcut 
 Service Analysis item is not affected by using Shortcuts, however at this stage we recommend not using Shortcuts to go backwards
 Improvements to conversation system and fewer unwanted interruptions 
 Menus can now only be used by Mouse and Controller
 Motion blur settings are now retained between maps


Updates

 New cutscene after completing the Caves
 New Loading screen

notes.title: Project Grove Demo Patch 1.01 Notes
notes.notes:
Thank you so much to everyone who has tried our Project Grove Demo so far. We've loved seeing all your Let's Plays and greatly appreciate all the feedback. Because of your efforts, we've been made aware of:

 System requirements - We're working hard on optimising the demo to ensure everyone can enjoy Project Grove! To help us out, we'd love to hear if you've had performance issues and what specs you're using.

 Smaller UI fixes - From control buttons to better subtitles, we'll be making improvements to increase accessibility and give you a more enjoyable experience.

 Ending - Watching streams and Let's Plays has shown the ending to this demo needs improvement. Stay tuned to experience the updated ending.


Updates in Project Grove Demo 1.01
Fixes

 Removed bug whereby pressing 'N' opened up an old menu

 Improved visual tutorial in the third cave puzzle
